title: Graph Beta: durable supersession preparation generation
description: Objective: land the missing production authority for graph.prepare_supersession and graph.release_preparation before transport wiring. Deliverable: a focused daemon service that derives a supersession preparation from the durable active graph, approved successor, current planning dispositions, funding and fence facts; commits one bounded preparation generation whose SupersessionFundingReservation and PreparedPlanningFence share target/deadline/lifecycle; and releases both atomically by exact generation. Hard dependencies: the canonical GraphRevisionContent decision/producer, task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23 current-active projection, and task-c4171c1cfe854cb78dd233794b342025 approved expansion binding. NOT in scope: HTTP/MCP registry wiring, graph.supersede activation, Foundation attempt ingress, or new runtime kinds. Consumer: task-efc2ef6330074b4d9893809f7425c95f. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test.
definitionOfDone: Production prepare reads the current active graph, approved target/preparation identity, complete planning disposition set, funding availability and fence membership from durable readers; the request cannot provide or replace any current authority fact.

One accepted prepare commits a single immutable generation containing the stored supersession plan identity plus paired HELD SupersessionFundingReservation and ACTIVE PreparedPlanningFence with identical goal, target revision, generation and deadline; at most one current generation exists.

Same-byte replay returns the original preparation without duplicate events or reservations; same decision identity with changed bytes, stale graph epoch/version, a sealed submission still finalizing, or changed consequence facts refuses with an exact code and layer and zero residue.

Release requires the exact current generation/version and no committed activation, then atomically transitions the paired reservation and fence to RELEASED/refunded; stale, foreign, repeated-conflict or unverifiable release fails closed while exact replay is idempotent.

Real SqliteEventStore tests assert exact code/layer and refusing service, nonzero hostile/race matrices, raw event/decision/reservation counts, one accepted prepare/release control, and production mutation drills for paired lifecycle, single-current-generation and caller-authority guards.
taskRails: Do not invent GraphRevisionContent authority or caller-provided current/funding/fence facts; wait for the named durable producers and human decision dec-64b2391cb80f4c0cbb6e88353017cc65.
Reuse the landed @moe/core/@moe/scheduler supersession, expansion-preparation, funding and disposition surfaces through public roots; preserve delegated code/layer/origin rather than restamping.
Keep preparation/release separate from activation and transport; TDD, target <=250 lines per production source and split before 400, explicit-path commit only.
